assumptions_and_limits: All dimensions are synthetic concept inputs and must not be used to cut, fabricate, install, or qualify a product.
Axis-aligned bounding boxes are a conservative screening approximation; no rotated, articulated, flexible, or exact CAD collision analysis is implemented.
A screening pass is not physical fit confirmation, ergonomics validation, safety assessment, appliance conformity, durability evidence, or permission to energize a unit.
A measured or qualified claim must be supported by controlled, revision-bound geometry evidence with SHA-256 digests and an independently reviewed physical test.
